question: From a structural point of view, all ecosystems consist of abiotic and biotic factors. Which of the following is a biotic factor of an ecosystem?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Green plants**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Green plants** are a biotic factor of an ecosystem.
 
• Biotic factors are living components of an ecosystem, which include plants, animals, and microorganisms.
 
• These factors interact with abiotic factors such as temperature, carbon dioxide, and atmospheric humidity to create a balanced ecosystem.
 
• Green plants play a crucial role in ecosystems by producing oxygen through photosynthesis and serving as a primary food source for herbivores.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP)** was established in 1972 and has been addressing critical environmental challenges since then.
 
• UNEP's headquarters are located in **Nairobi, Kenya**.
 
• UNEP is a leading global voice on the environment and sets the environmental agenda within the United Nations system.
 
• In March 2022, UNEP celebrated its 50th anniversary.
